description: Remove your own finished videos from your Switch video list and the Video page. Call it first without confirm: it lists exactly what would be removed and changes nothing. Then, once the person agrees, call again with confirm true. A video still being made stays (stop it with cancel_my_task). Up to 50 at a time. Only your own videos. Free.

confirm.description: Leave it out first: the answer says exactly what would be removed. Set true only after the person agrees.

name: delete_my_videos
title: Delete Videos
